fixes.explanation: That's right. "Jesus stopped and directed that the man be brought to Him." (Luke 18:40) Jesus stops, and He wants this man brought to Him. When the man comes near, Jesus asks him a question. It's the one in Luke 18:41.

True, baker. Jesus says, "Receive your sight!" and then, "Your faith has healed you." (Luke 18:42) Those are His words to the man near Jericho. The man had asked to see again, and that is what happens next (Luke 18:41, 43).
